readmeExcerpt:
# Fresh Start

This is the repository formerly known as `nirholas/claude-code`, the most widely forked mirror of the
Claude Code source leak of 31 March 2026. It is the same repository object, so
`github.com/nirholas/claude-code` still redirects here.

**It contains no Anthropic source code, and it will not.** The contents were removed after Anthropic's
DMCA notice. That notice has not been retracted.

## Read this instead

**[HISTORY.md](HISTORY.md)** is the full record: what leaked and how, what the DMCA did and did not
cover, and the correction that still needs making.

The short version of the correction: **Claude Code has never contained a cryptocurrency wallet or an
autonomous payment system.** The x402 payment code that circulated with copies of this leak was mine.
I wrote it, on top of the leaked tree, while building a project of my own. It was not Anthropic's and
it was not in the leak. Several popular writeups still report it as an undocumented Anthropic feature.
[HISTORY.md](HISTORY.md) shows three independent ways to verify that it is not, and gives a complete
accounting of every file I changed.

If you are auditing a copy of the leak you already hold, `grep -r x402 src/` is the test.

## Do not run copies of the leak

The leaked tree imports internal packages that do not exist on the public npm registry, and squatters
publish malicious packages under exactly those names. Installing dependencies from any copy of this
codebase can execute arbitrary code on your machine. There were also genuinely trojanized "Claude Code
leak" repositories in circulation in April 2026, documented by Zscaler ThreatLabz, distributing Vidar
and GhostSocks through a Windows executable. Use the official Claude Code CLI from Anthropic.


## License

All rights reserved. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

aiSummary.oneLiner: The definitive, sanitized mirror and historical record of the 2026 Claude Code source leak.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Fresh Start serves as the primary historical archive and sanitized mirror for the widely publicized March 2026 Claude Code source leak. Originally hosted as 'nirholas/claude-code', the repository was purged of all proprietary Anthropic source code following a DMCA takedown notice. Today, it acts as a transparent record detailing exactly what was leaked, what the DMCA covered, and specifically refuting the false claims that Claude Code contained an autonomous cryptocurrency wallet. The repository provides a verifiable audit trail proving that the 'x402' payment integration was an independent modification, not an undocumented Anthropic feature, while warning users against downloading trojanized copies of the original leak circulating online.
keyFeatures: Sanitized historical archive: Replaces the DMCA-takedown codebase with a comprehensive, legally compliant historical record of the leak.
Cryptocurrency rumor refutation: Provides verifiable proof and audit steps to demonstrate that the leaked x402 payment code was not written by Anthropic.
Malware warnings: Documents and warns users about the active threat of trojanized leak copies distributing Vidar and GhostSocks malware.
Dependency squatting awareness: Highlights the risks of running the original leaked tree due to malicious actors squatting on internal npm package names.
Direct project continuation: Serves as a redirect and historical context hub for the author's continued x402 work in the 'agenti' repository.

useCases.title: Historical Auditing
useCases.description: Tech journalists and security researchers review the repository's HISTORY.md to understand the exact scope and timeline of the Claude Code leak.

useCases.title: Codebase Verification
useCases.description: Developers who acquired copies of the leak use the provided grep commands to verify whether their copy contains the author's independent x402 modifications.

useCases.title: Security Awareness
useCases.description: Cybersecurity teams reference the repository to track the specific malware strains (Vidar, GhostSocks) being distributed via fake leak mirrors.

useCases.title: Project Redirection
useCases.description: Users searching for the original x402 payment integration are safely redirected to the author's clean, independent 'agenti' project.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This repository is for security researchers, tech historians, and developers looking for accurate information regarding the Claude Code leak. It serves as a static informational archive rather than executable software.
